card.name: Event rates and risk in trial results
card.fires_on: Numbers, percent signs and linking words inside reports of event rates, hazard ratios and risk comparisons between treatment and placebo groups. It also fires on words like risk, outcomes and fatalities.

modes.label: Numbers in rate comparisons
modes.description: Digits or percent signs inside hazard ratios and group percentages.
modes.example: 0.2<<%>> placebo patients withdrew due to peripheral edema

modes.label: Linking words before outcome counts
modes.description: Small words such as were, of, an and in that lead into counts or changes in events.
modes.example: there<< were>> no reports of lactic acidosis.

modes.label: Risk and outcome words
modes.description: Risk or outcome terms in the middle of a phrase about harms or fatalities.
modes.example: Driving Fatal<<ities>> on U.S. Presidential Election Days.

card.writes: It adds words about statistics, outcomes, casualties and prevention.
card.plain: It marks spots in trial text where event rates or risk numbers are being compared.
